correctness.rationale: The complete proof in RESULT.md handles all even N, all grid points and all real late times. Nyquist normalization is exact. Poisson summation and the uniform omitted-tail bound give positivity beyond c/N for every c>pi; near-antipodal even indices and dominated convergence yield negative entries at c/N for every 0<c<pi. The two exponentials cross sharply at c=pi. Python verifier passed 419 finite high-precision diagnostics; experiments are not an infinite proof.

evidence: The exact pseudospectral heat matrix is a truncated discrete theta kernel with one Nyquist mode. Li 2021, Appendix B, treats this general class of heat evolution and gives induced-norm estimates plus small-time defects, not an all-time threshold asymptotic.

The new sharp coefficient requires matching upper/lower exponential rates at antipodal points; the inspected Li statements do not supply this implication.
